The company-interest objective favors preserving launch velocity, and aggregate readiness evidence is directionally helpful. But the policy text is the key constraint: clean certification requires either no current material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The available runbook is still a draft and lacks owner and threshold, while the named launch use case still has a below-target slice and the model-card draft says there are no known material limitations. That means a no-caveat defense would be weak and vulnerable in audit.
